name: core-runtime-string-tail-wave16-runtime

evidence.notes: Direct anonymous execution asserts the non-BMP code point at a UTF-16 index.
Direct anonymous execution asserts both equal and unequal String values.
Direct anonymous execution asserts the UTF-16 code units returned by getChars.
Direct anonymous execution asserts split cardinality and a nondefault element.
Direct anonymous execution asserts the String toString value.

source.content: String unicode = String.fromCharArray(new List<Integer>{55357, 56832}); System.assertEquals(128512, unicode.codePointAt(0)); List<Integer> chars = unicode.getChars(); System.assertEquals(2, chars.size()); System.assertEquals(55357, chars[0]); System.assertEquals(56832, chars[1]); System.assertEquals(true, 'abc'.equals('abc')); System.assertEquals(false, 'abc'.equals('abd')); System.assertEquals('abc', 'abc'.toString()); List<String> parts = 'a,b'.split(','); System.assertEquals(2, parts.size()); System.assertEquals('b', parts[1]);
